property.name: mapreduce.framework.name
property.description: Run MapReduce through YARN (not the local runner).

property.name: mapreduce.application.classpath
property.description: Keeps container classpaths identical to the client's.

property.name: mapreduce.map.memory.mb
property.description: Map containers are small: every map stage here reads at most a 500 KB document.

property.name: mapreduce.map.java.opts
property.description: Heap below the container size, leaving room for the JVM and off-heap sort buffers.

property.name: mapreduce.reduce.memory.mb
property.description: Reducers get half again a mapper: the inverted index and the join hold the most state.

property.name: mapreduce.reduce.java.opts
property.description: Heap below the container size for the same reason as the map side.

property.name: yarn.app.mapreduce.am.resource.mb
property.description: The ApplicationMaster is small; giving it a worker-sized container wastes a slot.

property.name: mapreduce.task.timeout
property.description: 15 minutes. The default 600 s killed healthy tasks on this laptop while the Docker VM was swapping: a task that is merely slow looks identical to a hung one. Deployed on real hardware this goes back to the default.

property.name: mapreduce.task.io.sort.mb
property.description: Shuffle buffer per map task. It must fit in the map heap (192 MB), so the pre-tuning 200 MB is not an option here; 64 MB still produces few spills at this document size.

property.name: mapreduce.task.io.sort.factor
property.description: Streams merged per pass during the shuffle.

property.name: mapreduce.map.output.compress
property.description: Off by default: the compression ablation turns it on explicitly and measures it.

property.name: mapreduce.map.speculative
property.description: Disabled so benchmark timings are not distorted by speculative copies.

property.name: mapreduce.reduce.speculative
property.description: Same reason: a speculative reducer doubles network traffic mid-measurement.

property.name: mapreduce.job.reduces
property.description: Cluster default; the reducer-scaling study overrides it per run.

property.name: mapreduce.jobhistory.address
property.description: JobHistory server on the master node (started by the NameNode entrypoint's image).
